description: This Java class is an implementation of a live command for retrieving a feature property in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract query class and implements retrieval and setting of command parameters related to feature identification and property pointers.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommand interface, encapsulating details necessary for live retrieval of feature properties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from a generic Command object, casting it to RetrieveFeatureProperty.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the specific property.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers and returns a new command instance.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates a new answer builder for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
